messages:
olivia: Heads-up — eu-west1 queue depth for model:mosaic-8b just jumped ~4x over the last 10m. p50 latency up to 2.1s, p95 ~3.8s. intake rate is steady so this looks like capacity/backpressure not traffic spike. KV-cache miss rate also up ~30%.

sam: thanks. any hot shards or node OOMs in the cluster? metrics show GPU util still high but not saturated?

olivia: no OOMs. GPU util at 85% cluster-wide but a few pods at 98%. Most of the growth is queued requests waiting for KVC refreshes and longer decode times.

dean: we should enable a short circuit-breaker on admission for eu-west1 for the model to prevent tail amplification. suggest: reject when queue_depth > 250 for 30s, and route rejected tokens to mosaic-8b-int8 fallback in apac or to hosted-short-timeout.

hao: agree. quick patch we can apply now — add a per-model admission rule and lower dev priority. also suggest temporary increase of burst pslots for critical customers only.

olivia: can one of you push the admission change? want to avoid manual node scale for now (costy). If circuit-breaker buys us time we can run targeted scale+cache warm later.

sam: I can patch the admission controller. applying conservative rule first: threshold 200, cooldown 60s. will also mark non-prod routes as low-priority.

sam: pushing rule now: ```json
{ "model": "mosaic-8b", "region": "eu-west1", "admission": { "queue_threshold": 200, "cooldown_secs": 60, "action": "reject_with_fallback", "fallback": { "model": "mosaic-8b-int8", "region_preference": ["ap-south1","ap-east1"], "max_latency_ms": 800 } } }
```

ci-bot: Admission config change queued in infra-config repo. CI checks passed, deploying to canary (eu-west1-canary)

dean: once canary green, roll to region. also open a quick ticket to warm KV caches for hot prefixes — that should reduce decode time.

hao: warmed a subset of shards for top 100 prefixes (manual warm, 10m job). will monitor hit-rate.

olivia: nice. watch latency and queue depth for next 15m. if p50 still >1.5s we consider transient reserve burst (activate extra pslots) or temporarily raise price-limited throttles for non-enterprise tokens.

sam: canary is green. rolling to eu-west1. starting with priority-only routes then all.

ci-bot: Rollout: canary->50%->100% scheduled. ETA 6m between steps.

(5m later)

hao: KV hit-rate improved from 68% -> 84% for warmed prefixes. queue depth dropped ~45%. p50 down to 1.1s.

olivia: great. keep the circuit-breaker in place for another 30m then re-evaluate. file a retro and cost estimate for the warm + any burst pslots we used.

dean: noted. short-term action summary: 1) admission rule applied 2) prefix warm job 3) monitor and consider burst pslots if relapse.

sam: logging the admission rule change and fallback routing so product can see QoS difference. also cc-ing ai-sre on ticket. :thumbsup:

olivia: thanks everyone. mark this thread resolved if no regressions in next 30m.

(-> thread pinned to eu-west1 incident:inc-queue-eu-warm)
